_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/casting/test_counter_to_exile.py. t_cte_negation is Force of Negation's counter without its pitch cost: counter target noncreature spell, exiled instead of going to its owner's graveyard. t_cte_dragon is Transcendent Dragon on a cheaper body: an if-you-cast-it enters trigger that counters a spell into exile and offers its controller a free cast of it. t_cte_unstoppable is a sorcery that can't be countered, so 'countered this way' has something to refuse.
